_about: Corrections to the vendored Smithy model, for shapes whose declared
pattern is stricter than the service it describes. A corrected pattern
keeps the member validated against what AWS really returns; the
alternative, listing the field as an accepted violation, would stop
Each correction pins the exact upstream pattern it replaces. If a
re-vendor changes that pattern, the loader fails rather than applying a
correction to text it was never written against.

_evidence: step's Action as the runbook names it, and the Automation actions
aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty, whose 26 letters after the prefix exceed
the shape's {3,25}. The correction admits 26 and changes nothing else.
